description: Daily realized PnL aggregation from position ledger
steps: Create src/prediction_data/gold/wallet_pnl.py
Aggregate wallet_position_ledger by (day_utc, wallet): sum realized_pnl_this_fill_usd, sum fees_usd, sum abs(qty_delta * price) as volume_usd, count fills as trades_count
Compute optional wins/losses: count fills where realized_pnl > 0 vs < 0
Only emit rows where trades_count > 0 (sparse output)
Write to S3 Gold Parquet: gold/wallet_pnl_daily/day=YYYY-MM-DD/part-*.parquet
Write ClickHouse DDL (MergeTree, ORDER BY (wallet, day_utc), TTL day_utc + INTERVAL 90 DAY)
Implement CH loader with configurable lookback

description: ClickHouse watchlist table for selective wallet computation
steps: Write ClickHouse DDL for gold_watchlist (ReplacingMergeTree, ORDER BY wallet_address)
Schema: wallet_address, added_at, notes (optional), active (bool)
Create src/prediction_data/gold/watchlist.py with add/remove/list functions
Add CLI commands: `prediction-data gold watchlist add ADDR`, `prediction-data gold watchlist list`, `prediction-data gold watchlist remove ADDR`
Create src/prediction_data/gold/wallet_mtm.py
For each watchlist wallet, load current positions from wallet_position_state
Join positions with market_mark_daily to get mark prices
Compute: equity_usd = sum(qty * mark_price), unrealized_pnl_usd = sum(qty * (mark_price - avg_cost)), exposure_gross_usd = sum(abs(qty * mark_price)), exposure_net_usd = sum(qty * mark_price)
Write to S3 Gold Parquet + CH with 90-day TTL
Handle missing marks gracefully (log warning, use last available mark or skip)

description: Per-position daily snapshots for watchlist wallets
steps: Create src/prediction_data/gold/position_snapshots.py
For each watchlist wallet and each open position, create daily snapshot row
Include: day_utc, wallet, platform, market_id, outcome_id, qty, avg_cost, mark_price, position_value_usd (qty * mark_price), unrealized_pnl_usd (qty * (mark_price - avg_cost))
Write to S3 Gold Parquet + CH with 90-day TTL
Support backfill: reconstruct historical snapshots from ledger + marks

description: CLI and testing for wallet metrics
steps: Implement `prediction-data gold compute-wallet-metrics --dt YYYY-MM-DD [--dry-run]`
This command computes: wallet_pnl_daily (all wallets), wallet_mtm_daily (watchlist only), wallet_position_snapshot_daily (watchlist only)
Write unit tests for PnL aggregation with known ledger data
Write unit tests for MTM computation with known positions and marks
Write integration test: full pipeline Silver trades → ledger → pnl + mtm + snapshots
